title: Verb Noun Adjective
author: Rybread
description:
You are on an adventure! And it's very safe! Also the narrator might have a mild case of dementia, and (perhaps through the power of homophones) certain words will unlock new powers, traits, and inventory items! It's up to you to get the 15 coins of the realm and get a real spiffy title!

Content warning: Grues
